bullet: Not running, still advertised (`F16.vscode-url-not-running`), known bug.
script:
control-agent-server api GET /api/vscode/status --expect 200 --check enabled eq true --check running eq false
control-agent-server api GET /api/vscode/url --expect 200 --check . eq '{"url": null}' --save F16.vscode-url-not-running/global  # bug
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/vscode/url" --expect 200 --check . eq '{"url": null}'  # bug
failed_command: control-agent-server api GET /api/vscode/url --expect 200 --check . eq '{"url": null}' --save F16.vscode-url-not-running/global
